The '''CZ-8X Eradicator Droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Czerka Sentient Resources Department]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It was made on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="flashpoint">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=flashpoint|Czerka Corporate Labs}}</ref>
